continuity: The required one hundred roots of each of twenty-four medicinal herb varieties have been collected in Cold-Ice Land.
The Divine Physician and Mungyeong are preparing the collected herbs and other ingredients for the Life-Restoring Great Technique, but treatment of Jeok Cheongang has not begun.
Jeok Cheongang has Formless Ultimate Poison inside his body; his Scorching Yang Qi currently contains the poison, while his Yin-Cold Qi remains unchanged.
The Life-Restoring Great Technique can regulate qi and untangle disrupted qi and blood but cannot detoxify Formless Ultimate Poison on its own.
Mungyeong believes the Sichuan Tang Clan may possess a legendary sacred artifact capable of detoxifying any poison, and the Myriad-Poison Ring Quest has been generated.
plot: After five days of labor in Cold-Ice Land, Jin Taekyung, Hyuk Mujin, Gung Gibang, and Cheongpung complete the collection of the required medicinal herbs. The Herb Slave of Cold-Ice Land Chain Quest and the Mountain Herb Gatherer Who Returned Alive from Hell Achievement are completed, granting Taekyung ten bonus points.

The Divine Physician initially plans to prepare the Life-Restoring Great Technique over seven days, but after three days he discovers that Jeok Cheongang's body contains Formless Ultimate Poison. The poison is being contained by his Scorching Yang Qi, so performing the technique without an antidote could leave the poison unchecked. Mungyeong proposes seeking the Sichuan Tang Clan's legendary antidote treasure, generating the Myriad-Poison Ring Quest.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung's party remains at Dong Feng's hidden clinic in Sichuan, concealed by the Mystic Gate Formation.
The required Cold-Ice Land herbs have been collected, and Dong Feng and Mungyeong are preparing them for Jeok Cheongang's treatment.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison inside his body.
Jeok Cheongang's Scorching Yang Qi is containing the poison, while his Yin-Cold Qi remains unchanged.
The Life-Restoring Great Technique cannot detoxify Formless Ultimate Poison by itself.
Mungyeong has proposed seeking a legendary Sichuan Tang Clan treasure said to detoxify any poison, and the Myriad-Poison Ring Quest is active.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal.
Tang Taesang was murdered, and Tang Sadok continues pursuing the culprit with members of the Sichuan Tang Clan.
The Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, the Emei Sect Leader, and three Emei Elders were killed on Mount Emei by a one-armed middle-aged man.

Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau's Young Bureau Head while investigating collaborators in Heo Jun's betrayal; Song Ilseom remains with her temporarily before seeking Ju Hogun's elixir in Xianyang.
open_questions: Does the Sichuan Tang Clan possess the legendary treasure capable of detoxifying Formless Ultimate Poison?
Can Taekyung's party obtain a viable antidote and save Jeok Cheongang before his treatment deadline?
Will Venerable Myoryeong complete treatment and recover from the Black Hand Seal?
Who is the one-armed middle-aged killer, what is his purpose, and is he connected to Tang Taesang's murder?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how will the Zhongnan Sect's leaders and wider organizers respond?
temporary_decisions: Render 활신대법 as Life-Restoring Great Technique.
Render 무형지독 as Formless Ultimate Poison.
Render 한빙초 as Cold-Ice Herb and 지옥에서 살아 돌아온 심마니 as Mountain Herb Gatherer Who Returned Alive from Hell.
Render 이독제독 as using poison to control poison.
